title: Low-Level Design
tagline: From SOLID and design patterns to real systems you can design, code and defend in an interview.
audience: a backend engineer who knows basic Java and wants to design clean, extensible classes and ace LLD interviews

tutor.name: Low-Level Design
tutor.about: Teaches low-level design (OOP, SOLID, design patterns, classic LLD case studies and a capstone) in Java to a backend engineer preparing for real work and interviews.
tutor.examples: Java 17 (classes, interfaces, enums, records), UML class and sequence diagrams
